answer: The wander report publishes the merge explicitly at each vault. Each collapsed cluster gets one kernel weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 284 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 107 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1307 identities would post 1606 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
